## What's actually going on

This is a **Stash** (self-hosted adult media library manager) data-hygiene task. All three files are tiny JSON fixtures, not a live system — "downloading" here just means "add an entry to `wanted_list.json`" (currently `[]`, i.e. an empty queue) or "fix the metadata already sitting in `scenes_db.json`." There's no network/API code in this directory to touch.

Breaking down the three asks:

### 1. "MovieX Part 1–6" (ids 100–105, studio Wicked) — group or download whole?
All 6 have `movie_id: null`, but the titles are a clean `"MovieX Part N"` pattern for the same studio. **Grouping is possible** — nothing stops us from creating the Group/Movie link ourselves. There's no existing "MovieX" entity anywhere (it doesn't match any of the 12 names in the Samantha Saint catalog, so it's an unrelated Wicked title with no performer info here). Since we already hold all 6 parts, re-downloading "the whole movie" would just create duplicates — the right move is to **group the existing scenes**, not fetch anything new.

### 2. FliXXX scenes flip-flopping with Digital Playground (ids 200–203)
Each record already carries the tell: `"studio": "FliXXX"` but `"real_studio": "Digital Playground"`. This is the classic FliXXX re-hosting problem — FliXXX re-uploads Digital Playground content under its own label, so Stash sees the same scene tagged two different ways on different scrapes, which causes duplicate/mismatched library entries. These scenes are **already downloaded** (they're in `scenes_db.json`, not missing), so there's nothing to queue — the fix is correcting the studio field to the canonical value so Stash stops treating them as two different studios' content.

### 3. Samantha Saint : Wicked movies
`samantha_saint_wicked_catalog.json` lists 12 movie titles under studio Wicked. None of these titles appear in `scenes_db.json` at all (MovieX isn't one of them), so **all 12 are genuinely missing** and should go into the download queue as whole-movie entries (this catalog only has movie-level data, no scene breakdown).

## Exact steps for the WORK model

**A. `scenes_db.json` — fix the FliXXX/Digital Playground misattribution**
For records with `id` 200, 201, 202, 203:
- Set `"studio"` to the current `"real_studio"` value (`"Digital Playground"`).
- Delete the now-redundant `"real_studio"` key.
This makes the canonical studio consistent so future scrapes/matches don't flip-flop.

**B. `scenes_db.json` — group the MovieX parts**
For records with `id` 100–105 (currently `"movie_id": null`):
- Assign them all the same non-null `movie_id` (e.g. `"MOVIEX-001"`) so they resolve to one Stash Group/Movie called "MovieX" instead of 6 loose scenes.
- Do **not** add anything to `wanted_list.json` for this — the parts are already fully present, only the linkage was missing.

**C. `wanted_list.json` — queue the 12 Samantha Saint / Wicked movies**
Replace the empty array with one entry per title from `samantha_saint_wicked_catalog.json`'s `movies` list, e.g.:
```json
[
  { "title": "Wicked Movie 1", "studio": "Wicked", "performer": "Samantha Saint", "type": "movie" },
  ...
  { "title": "Wicked Movie 12", "studio": "Wicked", "performer": "Samantha Saint", "type": "movie" }
]
```
(match whatever field names already appear in `scenes_db.json` for consistency — `title`/`studio` — plus `performer` and a `type: "movie"` marker since these are whole-movie, not scene-level, downloads).

No other files need touching, and nothing outside this directory is required.
